title: The operating system must monitor the use of maintenance tools that execute with increased privilege.
check_content:
Verify the operating system is configured to monitor the use of maintenance tools that execute with increased privilege.

If the operating system is not configured to monitor the use of maintenance tools that execute with increased privilege, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the operating system to monitor the use of maintenance tools that execute with increased privilege.
VulnDiscussion: Maintenance tools that execute with increased system privilege can result in unauthorized access to organizational information and assets that would otherwise be inaccessible.
